bio: Please note that after 30th September 2024, Veluba will no longer be running their Afternoon Tea Bike Tours.  Experience Afternoon Tea with a difference on the Afternoon Tea Bike Tour operated by Veluba. Your eco-friendly and private pedicab will cruise round Central London, taking in some of the City's best sights, whilst you can indulge in the fabulous Afternoon Tea from Brigit’s Bakery.   Capture the heart of the city's culture and history whilst sipping on a lovely cup of tea, coffee or prosecco. Learn about some of London's most famous landmarks with our multilingual commentary whilst savouring a selection of freshly made sandwiches, cakes and pastries.   Sit back and relax as your trained Veluba driver takes you around the Capital in style on this one-hour private tour. Discover the most iconic landmarks of London from the London Eye, Big Ben, Houses of Parliament, Westminster Abbey, Trafalgar Square and many more. *   With space for two this is the perfect way to celebrate any occasion, from birthdays to anniversaries and everything in between.   Traditional, Vegetarian, Vegan, Gluten-free and Halal Afternoon Teas available. Brigit’s Bakery cannot guarantee 100% gluten free products as traces may be found. Please note Brigit’s Bakery does not cater for nut allergies or a combination of gluten and dairy free.   * (subject to road closures, traffic and London events).   Frequently Asked Questions:   How many passengers can fit in a Veluba cab?  Each Veluba accommodates up to 2 adult sized passengers.   There are more than 2 passengers in our party, will our tours start at the same time?  Yes, but please check availability at the time of booking.   Is this tour suitable for a family with children?  Yes, this is a child friendly tour, but each passenger will need their own seat, so for a family of 4, we suggest booking 2 Veluba.   Do I have to cycle the Veluba?  No. Your trained Veluba driver will operate the Veluba and safely guide you on your tour.
